en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a wintry riverside landscape in a city. Prominently featured is an arched metal bridge spanning a river, with snow covering the ground and leafless trees lining the embankment. Several buildings are visible on the far bank of the river. The postcard includes printed text at the top identifying the location as Graz and the bridge as Ferdinands-Brücke.
